title: Verify Robotics module AGV state machine generates Geek Plus execution commands from Sorter Sweeper tote tasks
summary: Validate the handoff from Sorter Sweeper tote tasks to the Robotics module’s AGV state machine and confirm that the Robotics module generates Geek Plus execution commands for the documented AGV task set (induct tote, remove tote, initialize AGV, go to, pick up tote, move tote, drop off tote, cancel request, go charge).
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm that tote tasks created by Sorter Sweeper are received by the Robotics module (AGV state machine) and that the Robotics module generates Geek Plus execution commands matching the expected AGV command/task names.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for physical safety actions (e.g., E-stop). This procedure is for validating software command generation/handoff behavior only.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the diagnostic checks to confirm tote-task reception by the Robotics module and verify Geek Plus command generation for the expected AGV task set.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to Robotics module command-generation evidence (exact live tool/screen not specified in the provided segment).
Access to Geek Plus command execution evidence (exact live tool/screen not specified in the provided segment).

steps.title: Confirm the Robotics module is the AGV state machine that receives tote tasks and generates Geek Plus commands
steps.purpose: Establish the expected software responsibility boundary before validating the tote-task handoff and command generation.
steps.instruction: On the live OptiSweep/WCS/Robotics command-generation evidence you have access to, confirm that the Robotics module is the component responsible for acting as the AGV state machine that receives tote tasks from Sorter Sweeper and generates commands for Geek Plus to execute.
steps.expected_result: You can observe that tote tasks originating from Sorter Sweeper are handled by the Robotics module as the AGV state machine, and that Geek Plus execution commands are produced from those tote tasks.
steps.healthy_condition: The live evidence shows Robotics module command generation activity corresponding to tote-task handling (not just Sorter Sweeper orchestration).
steps.failure_condition: Live evidence indicates tote tasks are received/processed by Sorter Sweeper but Robotics module does not generate Geek Plus execution commands.

actions.label: Verify Robotics module state-machine responsibility
actions.exact_action: Confirm Robotics module acts as the state machine for the AGVs and generates commands for Geek Plus to execute those tasks.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot find any live evidence that Robotics module generates Geek Plus commands from tote tasks, stop and escalate for deeper Robotics module / Geek Plus command-generation troubleshooting.

steps.title: Verify the Robotics module receives tote tasks from the Sorter Sweeper module
steps.purpose: Confirm the first handoff: Sorter Sweeper tote-task creation/orchestration reaches the Robotics module.
steps.instruction: Using the live evidence you have access to for Robotics module command generation and/or Robotics-side task/command tracking, verify that tote tasks created by Sorter Sweeper are present/consumed by the Robotics module.
steps.expected_result: For the relevant tote tasks, Robotics module shows corresponding command-generation activity (or command records) that indicate it received/processed those tote tasks.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote-task-driven command generation is observable in Robotics-side evidence (e.g., command records progressing through statuses).
steps.failure_condition: Tote tasks are present at Sorter Sweeper, but there is no corresponding Robotics module command-generation activity for those tasks.

steps.title: Check that the Robotics module generates Geek Plus commands for the expected AGV task set
steps.purpose: Validate the second handoff: Robotics module command generation matches the documented AGV task/command names that Geek Plus should execute.
steps.instruction: For the relevant tote tasks, verify that the Robotics module generates Geek Plus execution commands corresponding to the documented AGV task set: induct tote, remove tote, initialize AGV, go to, pick up tote, move tote, drop off tote, cancel request, go charge.
steps.expected_result: Support can confirm that for the relevant tote tasks, the Robotics module produces Geek Plus execution commands corresponding to the documented AGV task set.
steps.healthy_condition: The generated command set includes the expected command/task names (Induct tote, Remove tote, Initialize AGV, Go to, Pickup tote, Move tote, Drop off tote, Cancel Request, Go Charge) for the tote-task sequence being validated.
steps.failure_condition: Geek Plus commands are not generated, or the generated command set does not match the documented task names.
